organization.name: Rivergate Kitchen
organization.mission: Feed hunger and build stronger communities by connecting people, food, and resources across the neighborhood.

volunteers.name: Maya Chen
volunteers.interests: Food security, education, and community service

opportunities.title: Community Food Distribution
opportunities.imageAlt: Volunteers in white shirts packing food aid boxes beside a van
opportunities.description: Pack and distribute nutritious food boxes to families across the neighborhood. Volunteers will assemble boxes, greet neighbors, and help load groceries into cars at our Rivergate Avenue kitchen.

opportunities.title: Community Garden Restoration
opportunities.imageAlt: Volunteer tending raised garden beds in a community garden
opportunities.description: Restore raised beds, plant fall cover crops, and prepare the garden for winter. No gardening experience needed — we will teach you everything on site.

opportunities.title: Library Tutoring
opportunities.imageAlt: Tutor reading a picture book with a young student in a library
opportunities.description: Support K–5 learners with reading and math in a calm, welcoming library space. Tutors commit to one afternoon a week and follow a ready-made activity plan.

opportunities.title: Senior Meal Delivery
opportunities.imageAlt: Volunteer helping an older neighbor from a car
opportunities.description: Deliver warm meals and a friendly check-in to homebound neighbors. Routes take about ninety minutes and include a brief wellness check.

opportunities.title: Park Cleanup & Beautification
opportunities.imageAlt: Volunteers collecting litter in a green park
opportunities.description: Remove litter, refresh planting beds, and repaint picnic tables along the waterfront. Gloves, grabbers, and refreshments are provided.

opportunities.title: Animal Shelter Support
opportunities.imageAlt: Volunteer feeding dogs at an animal shelter
opportunities.description: Socialize shelter dogs, refresh kennels, and prepare enrichment toys. Every session helps a pet become more adoptable.

opportunities.title: Pantry Setup
opportunities.imageAlt: Volunteers organizing shelf-stable food donations at a pantry
opportunities.description: Sort donations, stock shelves, and check dates before the weekly pantry opens. This is a quiet, steady morning shift with a big payoff.

opportunities.title: Neighborhood Mural Project
opportunities.imageAlt: Students and neighbors painting a colorful outdoor mural together
opportunities.description: Bring a neighborhood wall to life with local artists. Volunteers prime panels, mix colors, and help younger painters — no art experience required.
